reviews.text: Service is always friendly and professional.

Everyone is so accommodating, my dog Bowser is pretty nervous and had to go in for surgery. Everyone was super kind and understanding throughout the exam and the intake. We were given clear outpatient procedures and everyone was super kind throughout the process. I absolutely will bring my other pets.
Thanks, Angela, for trusting us with your pet's care! ❤️

I cannot say enough wonderful things about The Corner Vet at Bellaire.

My 17-year-old dog, Prince, recently underwent surgery to remove an extremely large mass. Because of his age and the size of the mass, I was terrified. The veterinarian was honest with me about the risks, took the time to answer my questions, and never made me feel rushed.
What meant the most was the compassion shown by the entire staff. They prayed over Prince before surgery, and the receptionist prayed throughout the time he was under, and everyone remained kind, positive, and supportive throughout the day. I spent hours worrying and crying, and they treated both Prince and me with so much care.
The surgery itself was very complex and lasted several hours. The veterinarian worked carefully and patiently to remove a massive growth while protecting the surrounding tissues. I was told the entire team, including the office manager, assisted during the procedure. Their dedication and teamwork were incredible.
When Prince woke up from anesthesia and was able to come home with me, I was overwhelmed with gratitude. The level of skill, professionalism, and genuine love for animals shown by this team is something I will never forget.
I drove across town to come to The Corner Vet at Bellaire because I felt comfortable and cared for here, and after this experience I know I made the right decision.
Thank you to the veterinarian and every member of the staff for giving my sweet Prince a chance and for treating him like family. You will always have my gratitude.

I had a wonderful experience at The Corner Vet. The staff was friendly, compassionate, and genuinely cared about my dog from the moment we walked in. The veterinarian took the time to thoroughly explain everything, answer my questions, and make sure I felt comfortable with the treatment plan.

The clinic was clean, organized, and efficient, and I never felt rushed during the appointment. It’s clear that everyone at The Corner Vet is dedicated to providing excellent care for pets and outstanding service to their owners.

I highly recommend The Corner Vet to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and professional veterinary team. Thank you for taking such great care of my dog!

I had a 4:15 appointment and literally saw the Vet at 5:10.  I think they forgot we were there.  I had to remind the receptionist.   Then the Vet kindly walked in the room Rubbed on the dog and gave us $26 dog treats($78 Visit).  The analysis was useless.  I still don’t know what’s wrong with the Dog. Sticking with Meyerland Veterinarian for now on!

Had to get an emergency surgery for our baby because our vet told us she might have pyometra & we called around to see if anyone had an opening. Luckily they were able to get us in last minute & thankfully she didn't have it! We finally got her fixed & amputated her injured tail. We are so thankful for the team for taking us in under such short notice. They took so much care of our baby. She's been doing well and haven't had any problems ❤️

They give mixed messages about really caring about your pet! I felt support there for Bella at the beginning. I'm quite aware it's a business and profits are important! But, the manager consistently mentioned how she gave me two allergy pills as sambles! Complimentary! Ok!!
I do understand it's a business! . But coming from another state, not from Houston, I'm used to  a vet, who I have seen for years! They always went out of there way for my dog, regardless of sometimes unfortunate financial circumstances. And would work with me.
They would NEVER ever turn their back and not give Bella the medicine she needs for her well-being!!! The Manager was holding on to Bella's medicine so tight, like I was going to take it and run out!? lol  I could have easily paid the $280!!  BUT, It was principal now and the managers fake, insincere, unprofessionalism that completely me turned off and how she did NOT care about Bella's well-being at all at that point! I had no respect toward her and her rude demeanor. I have been a Regional Sales Executive for years, and when a customer is upset, because one of her staff told me the medication was $30 plus office visit, which I saw on paper, then I get to the front desk And was over 4X that price!! She admitted she verbally told me the wrong price. Fine!! But as a prior manager, when there's a mistake on YOUR part, you meet in the middle or offer maybe a 15% discount something to make the customer not upset!! And show decency NOT to completely repeat herself like a robot!! The manager you have there, is immature and unprofessional. She's stubborn as a mule and rude in a very passive way!! Then she had the nerve to tell me outside after I PAID, we're not going to treat Bella anymore!! Ha! Like I would bring Bella back there!!??  Which proved my point of not caring for Bella's well-being, who is just innocent in this situation!
